book.name: 2 Korenta
book.title: Fiisi Pool kanakɗoh kaɓɗoh ɓi Korenta

content: Kañɗohi
Mi yii kañɗis ɗu, ɗu ɓi Janguuniŋ Kooh nik ŋ Korenta na ɓooɓiŋ Kooh ŋ Akaay jen. Mi yi Pool, ApootariŋKiristaani Yeesu ŋ waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh, ñam na fiisee ɗu kaytii, mi na ɓaah ɓoo Timoote.
Kooh Baabiŋ ɓoo baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam ; Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam !
Giifɗiŋ miskiɗ ci
Kooh, yi nik Koohiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa, a nammba nik Baabiŋ ɗe, a yakɗaah, a yi Baabi, yi ɓooɓi jen na miske, Kooh yi na giifɗohe ŋ in nu nik.
A yi na giifɗe ɓoo
ngaŋ miskiɗ ciŋ ɓoo jen ne ɓoo min giifiɗ ɓi nik ngaŋ miskiɗ nu nik ! Ŋ ineem ɓoo giifiɗ ɓa na giifɗi a giifɗoh ɓoo.
Findi miskiɗ ci ɓoo ɓaah na Kiristaani laayoh, giifɗi Kooh na giifɗe ɓoo taamboh ŋ Kiristaani laayoh ɗaa.
Ɓoo nik ŋ miskiɗ ɗah, ɓoo nik nga ne ɗu giifɗu, ɗu nam muc ; ɓoo giifɗu ɗah, wa giifɗohaa ɗu ne ɗu ndengɗuk, ɗu min muñ miskiɗ ciŋ ɗu mand na ciŋ ɓoo.
Te yaakaari ɓoo raak nga ɗu ndengiɗ, ɓoo inhiɗ ne findi ɗu na ɓaahohe ŋ miskiɗ ci, ɗu na ɓaahohe ɗaa ŋ giifɗi.
Kon ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo, ɓoo waaɗiɗ ne ɗu inah miskiɗ ci rahas ɓoo ŋ kur caŋ Asi : Ɓoo degseen miskiɗ keeh-keeh po ɓoo antalisseeɗi ca, ɓoo liiɓeeɗi sah ne ɓoo hey rise pes.
Ɓoo ambee ne sah ɓoo joy joy kaan ; ineem raakiɗ ne ɓoo oolkohuu haf ɓoo, ɓoo oolkoh Kooh yi na hultiɗe kaaniɗ ci.
A yi muciɗ ɓoo ŋ kakaan ki miskiɗeem, te a hey ɓoo mucɗisse. Ɓoo oolkiɗ ne a genan ɓoo muciɗ.
Kiimi ɗu kiimɗee ɓoo Kooh nam ɓaah nga ; ŋ ineem, ɓo' laayiɗ kiimɗiɗ ɓoo, tahha po ɓo' laayiɗ hey corkiɗe Kooh ŋ baahohi a baahoh ɓoo.
Pool oorɗiɗ ɓaaɓiŋ ɗe Korenta

Inii weɗ ɓoo na ndamkohe te liiɓ ciŋ ɓoo seede'iɗa, weɗ ne : Keeh na hool puloh ŋ Kooh, ceɗ ɓoo na pesohe na ɓi Adina, ɓoo na uupe ca pesoh na ɗu. Nikɗi haa ne wa ñaañi puloh ŋ ɓo' on ɓoo ineem, waaye wa baahohiŋ Kooh.

Ɓoo na fiiseeɗi ɗu in wiiriis ɗal ini ɗu min jang te ɗu inaha. Raakiɗ ini ɗu camb inah, te ŋ liiɓiɗ ne ɗu heya inhe jen, weɗ ne ŋ mbehi Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu dokkohan, ɗu hey neɓse nga ɓoo, te ɓoo neɓu nga ɗu.
Ineem wooreen ndo, weɗ tah po ŋ ammba ne ŋ kockohan nga ɗu ne ɗu sum ŋ kot ci kanak ci ŋ raakan ndeem.
Weɗ ne ŋ waaɗeen taamboh nga ɗu ne ŋ hayee Maseduwaan ndii ɗah ; te ŋ namee wiiruk ɗah, ŋ taambis nga ɗu ne ɗu ɓaatɗoh ho ŋ ɓaaɓiŋ ngo ŋ waas Yudee.
Ɗu liiɓ ne wi ŋ woyee ŋ ɗooƴ co ne ineem weɗ maa hee tume, ŋ liiɓɗi liiɓɗi nga e ? Wala ɗu liiɓ ne ŋ raak liiɓohaaɗ ɓo' dong, po "ee"-iŋ ngo miniɗ nik "a'aa" ne ŋ tufuk ne ŋ tum in ɗah ?
Wa wooriɗ Kooh ne, woo ki ɓoo na woyee ɗu wa "ee" na "a'aa" haa.
Laam Kuɓkiŋ Kooh, Yeesu Kiristaa yi ɓoo woyee ɗu, mi na Silweng na Timoote, a "ee" na "a'aa" haa ; a moos nik "ee" dong.
Te in ci Kooh gapoh, ini ca laay jen, ca "ee" ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa. Ineem weɗ nam tah po wa taamboh nga ɗe, ɓoo woyee "amiin" weɗ "ee", ne ɓoo yakiɗ Kooh.
A Kooh ambsoh ɓoo na ɗu, a ndengiɗta ɓoo ŋ Kiristaani, a degiɗ ɓoo ne ɓoo pangkiɗ ɗe.
A ñaassa ɓoo, a tummba Fuuɗsiŋ ɗe ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓoo, ineem nikka firnde ne in ci a gap ɓoo jen, ɓoo hey ca rahse.
Kon Kooh miniɗ to seede, ŋ lee ɗah, ŋ kaanaat : Ŋ sang ɗu ɓek miskiɗ weɗ tah ŋ hayisɗi Korenta poyi.
Nikɗi haa ne ɓoo waaɗ ɗu deg yaah ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kosiŋ ɗu laam ɗu ndengiɗ nga. Ɓoo kay, ɓoo na ɓaatɗohee ɗu ŋ sumiŋ ɗu.

footnotes.text: Waas laayiɗ, Pool woyee ndii ɗah, a na woye "ɓoo". Fu kerah "ɓoo" ɗah, wa miniɗ nik ne a na woye haf ce dong, wala a yi na ɓi ɓo' wiiriis. Ŋ kaɓɗoh ciŋ jamanoonaam, wa mandee ɗaa.
